experiment: Deno randomized paired full scan versus compiled binding graph with matched input mutation and diagnostics disabled

protocol.order: balanced randomized within pair; per-scenario deterministic xorshift seed
protocol.changedIds: stratified evenly spaced unique IDs; identical across arms
protocol.inputAccounting: both arms iterate the same changed IDs and update source values; scan also marks dirty flags before full scan
protocol.instrumentation: flush statistics disabled in the timed graph path; counters use the known one-edge-per-source topology
protocol.host: Float64Array; equal number of host-buffer writes
protocol.setup: graph constructed before timed samples; setup excluded
